# Plan My Japan

> > Your comprehensive guide to planning travel in Japan, from Tokyo and Osaka to Fukuoka and beyond, with detailed city guides, cultural insights, and practical tips for budget dining, shopping, and attractions.

Plan My Japan helps travelers discover Japan's major cities, cultural experiences, and practical travel information. The site covers everything from UNESCO heritage sites and Pokemon Centers to convenience store dining and vending machine culture, with a focus on accessible, budget-friendly exploration of Japanese destinations.

## Key Topics

- Japan travel planning
- Tokyo attractions and neighborhoods
- Osaka day trips and districts
- Fukuoka temples and shopping
- Budget dining chains (Kura Sushi, Denny's, Yakiniku Like)
- Convenience stores (7-Eleven, FamilyMart, Lawson)
- Japanese food culture
- Shopping malls and Pokemon Centers
- UNESCO heritage sites
- Japanese vending machines
- Nara deer park
- Booking platforms (booking.com, Agoda, Hostelworld)
- Tour services (Get Your Guide, Viator, Klook)
- Travel connectivity (Airalo)
- Chain restaurants and konbini culture

## Major City Guides

- [Shinjuku, Tokyo - 33 Things To Do Guide + Photos](https://www.planmyjapan.com/things-to-do-shinjuku-tokyo): Shinjuku Tokyo guide: Golden Gai, Kabukicho & top attractions
- [Nagoya, Japan - 34 Things To Do + Photos](https://www.planmyjapan.com/things-to-do-nagoya-japan): Comprehensive Nagoya attractions guide including Ghibli Park
- [Nara, Japan - 26 Things To Do Guide + Photos](https://www.planmyjapan.com/nara-japan-things-to-do): Nara travel guide: UNESCO sites, deer park, and day trips from Osaka
- [Shinsekai, Osaka - 20 Things To Do Guide + Photos](https://www.planmyjapan.com/shinsekai-osaka-things-to-do): Shinsekai Osaka guide: vintage district with Tsutenkaku Tower & kushikatsu
- [10 Easy Day Trips From Osaka Guide + Photos](https://www.planmyjapan.com/easy-day-trips-from-osaka): Best day trips from Osaka including Himeji, Nara, and Kobe by train

- [Nankinmachi - Kobe Chinatown in Japan Guide + Photos](https://www.planmyjapan.com/nankinmachi-kobe-chinatown-japan): Nankinmachi Chinatown guide in Kobe with Chinese cuisine & culture
- [Tokyo Marunouchi Christmas Lights 2025](https://www.planmyjapan.com/tokyo-marunouchi-christmas-lights): Tokyo Marunouchi Christmas lights guide featuring Super Mario displays

## Temples & Cultural Sites

- [Nanzoin Temple Reclining Buddha in Fukuoka, Guide + Photos](https://www.planmyjapan.com/nanzoin-temple-reclining-buddha-fukuoka): Nanzoin Temple guide featuring world's largest bronze reclining Buddha
- [Sapporo TV Tower in Hokkaido: Guide + Photos](https://www.planmyjapan.com/sapporo-tv-tower-japan): Sapporo TV Tower guide with observation deck and Odori Park views
